title: Opalescent Cascading Planet (0340f9): graph-estate consolidation claim open
body: Executing graph-estate-consolidation.plan.md t2+t3+t4 -> t5+t7 -> scoped t8 as one ship-unit on feat/graph-tooling-tidyup (base b4acc59d).
